originals.citation: Rusbult, C. E., & Lowery, D. (1985). When bureaucrats get the blues: Responses to dissatisfaction among federal employees. Journal of Applied Social Psychology.

quote: When Bureaucrats Get the Blues: A Replication and Extension of the Rusbult and Lowery Analysis of Federal Employee Responses to Job Dissatisfaction
notes: Re-analyses the 1979 Federal Employee Attitude Survey used by Rusbult and Lowery.
